scope: Primary held-out T1 versus B0 decision only; collapse, dataset, encoder, context-target, budget, and reproduce-command gates remain separate blockers.

comparison.pairing: same confirmatory examples within the same frozen seed

material_effect.rationale: Carry forward the predecessor study's already-established 2 percentage-point practical-effect threshold instead of choosing a more permissive successor-specific margin after prior negative evidence.

seed_consistency.h2_gate: at least 4 of 5 frozen seeds have strictly positive paired accuracy delta

uncertainty.inner_pair_definition: for each sampled example, resample the paired correctness difference 1[T1 correct]-1[B0 correct]
uncertainty.aggregate_statistic: mean paired accuracy delta across resampled seeds after within-seed example resampling
uncertainty.directional_gate: lower endpoint must be strictly greater than 0
uncertainty.rounding_policy: evaluate gates on unrounded floating-point values; round only for display

claim_boundary: These are pre-outcome decision rules only. They do not authorize execution, do not establish a positive result, and do not resolve the remaining scientific or reproducibility blockers.
